description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_InventoryRestock" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restock">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestock" name="Inventory Restock Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Monitor" name="Inventory monitoring started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdCheck" name="Threshold reached?" default="Flow_NotReached"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlertOrManualSplit" name="Automated alert or manual check?"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Send automated reorder alert"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual stock check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderMerge" name="Reorder needed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier">
      <bpmn:documentation>Procurement team places the order considering cost, delivery time and supplier reliability.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockReceived" name="Stock received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlacementSplit" name="Shelves or storage?"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceInStorage" name="Place stock in storage"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlacementMerge" name="Stock placed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete, inventory levels updated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMonitor" sourceRef="Start_Monitor" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReached" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdCheck" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdCheck" targetRef="Gateway_AlertOrManualSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock level has reached the predefined threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertOrManualSplit" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertOrManualSplit" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlertToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToPlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrderToUpdateDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDeliveryToReceived" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Event_StockReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToInspect" sourceRef="Event_StockReceived" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToRecord" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToPlacementSplit" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_PlacementSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToShelves" name="Shelves" sourceRef="Gateway_PlacementSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToStorage" name="Storage" sourceRef="Gateway_PlacementSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceInStorage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShelvesToPlacementMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Gateway_PlacementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StorageToPlacementMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInStorage" targetRef="Gateway_PlacementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlacementMergeToUpdateLevels" sourceRef="Gateway_PlacementMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevelsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="End_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
